notes.title: Quatro Luzes patch 1.0.3a released!
Quatro Luzes patch 1.0.3a released!
Quatro Luzes 1.0.2 is finally here!
notes.content:
The new patch is now available for download, featuring customizable hotkeys, profile manager, and more!

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Input Manager: the player now is able to customize the game's hotkeys;[/b]
[*][b]Deleting option for profiles added to the Load menu;[/b]
[*]Engine update to version 5.3.1;
[*]New global illumination system;
[*]Camera movement redone in some levels (mainly the Yellow World);
[*]No more ghosts in the level "The Labirinth".
[/list]
[i]Fixed:[/i]
[list]
[*]Bug that causes new profiles to be able to use all colors of a previous game, after returning, via in-game menu, to the main menu;
[*]Jump input not always being recognized;
[*]Bug that causes wall jumping to throw the player upwards with double the distance;
[*]Ending animation not triggering properly, causing Atlas to be misplaced in the final cutscene.
[/list]
[i]Known issues:[/i]
[list]
[*]Unexpected physics interaction between movable cubes and yellow springs.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1a released
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
    [*] When getting a spirit, and option to keep playing the same level will appear, in case a level have more than one spirit.
    [*] Rework on some levels' checkpoints, specially in the blue nexus.
    [*] New keyboard controls and shortcuts.
    [*] Player collision detection increased slightly.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
    [*] Minor physics bugs in certain mechanics (mainly the gold spring) are being looked into.
[/list]

Note: Unity does not support input editing. A third party plugin is being tested for this purpose.
